user.title: Connect to NuaSense
user.description: An API key from platform.nuasense.com → API Keys, with the ingest:write scope. It only reads your own stations here.

station.title: Your station and your garden
station.description: Watering today is worked out for what the garden mostly is. The sprinkler rate turns millimetres into minutes; use 0 if you only want millimetres. Advanced adds the agronomy values (spray window, ET0 per hour, leaf wetness, VPD, delta T).

error.invalid_auth: NuaSense did not accept this key.
error.no_stations: This account has no stations yet. Add one in the console under External stations.

abort.already_configured: This station is already set up.
